Goal: I can show that two reflections make a translation or a rotation.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Theorem: reflecting across two parallel lines is a translation by twice the distance between the lines, perpendicular to them. Reflecting across two lines that cross at O is a rotation about O by twice the angle between the lines.

That is why two mirrors at 60 degrees act like a 120 degree turn and show a ring of images in a kaleidoscope. Order matters: reflecting across m and then n turns one way; n and then m turns the other way.
